intent: A destructive-action button you have to hold. A fill sweeps left to right with the label inverting exactly at its edge, springs back if you let go, and confirms with a small shake.

stack.animation: motion/react (one motion value for progress, springs, useAnimate for the shake, AnimatePresence for label swaps, useInView for the demo entrance)

layout.button: CSS grid; all label states stacked invisibly in one cell so width = longest state and never changes
layout.sm: 36px tall, radius 9px, padding 0 12px, 13px text, 14px icon, gap 6px, ::before extends hit area to 44px
layout.md: 44px tall, radius 11px, padding 0 18px, 14px text, 16px icon, gap 8px
layout.fill: absolute full-size layer clipped with inset(0 (1-p)*100% 0 0); contains an inverse-coloured copy of the label
layout.edge: 1px line + 24px gradient trail positioned at p, hidden at 0 and 1
layout.hint: tooltip above, 8px gap, 12px text, 7px radius, with a 6px rotated-square arrow
layout.demo: 600px card: header with a counting '3 of 3', three project rows with grey monograms and sm buttons, empty state, footer with md workspace button; sub-component ProjectRow, hooks useTimers

color.approach: monochrome first: the red fill is the one accent (accent prop). Every button colour is mixed in CSS from two variables, --hc-tint (the fill for danger, the ink for neutral) and --hc-ink, with color-mix against transparent so it sits on any surface
color.surface: tint 8% over transparent, inset ring tint 24%; hover 12% / 36%
color.label: color-mix(tint 62%, ink); focus outline the same colour
color.fill: danger #e5484d (light theme #dc2626) or neutral = theme ink (#ececee dark, #18181b light); inverse label black or white by luminance
color.edge: color-mix(fill 45%, white) hairline plus a 24px gradient trail at 35%
color.ink: dark #f4f4f5, light #18181b; tooltip ink background with the opposite text
color.demo: #000 stage, #0b0b0c card, white/8% ring, #8a8a93 meta, grey #18181b monogram tiles with #a1a1aa initials (no tinted tiles)

motion.hold: pointer down or Space/Enter down: scale 0.98 (100ms); p animates linearly to 1 over (1-p)*duration, default 1200ms
motion.release: p springs to 0, stiffness 420, damping 40; also on blur, pointercancel or moving >16px off the button
motion.quickTap: under 260ms: fill nudges to 10% and back over 500ms, tooltip shows for 1.7s
motion.confirm: navigator.vibrate(12); shake x [0,-3,3,-2,2,-1,0] over 340ms; call onConfirm
motion.pending: spinner + pendingLabel while the returned promise is unsettled
motion.labelSwap: in from y 7px, blur 3px, 260ms ease-out; out to y -7px in 160ms ease-in
motion.done: check path draws in over 340ms; after resetAfter (2400ms) the fill drains over 450ms
motion.error: shake, fill springs back, alert icon + errorLabel for 2.6s
motion.reducedMotion: fill still tracks the hold; no shake, spring or blur; 150ms fades; demo blocks fade in over 150ms and numbers set instantly
motion.demoEntrance: once at 30% in view: card rises 12px out of an 8px blur (0.5s ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]), header at 60ms with '0 of 3' counting up to '3 of 3' (0.6s, blur clearing), rows from 0.16s 60ms apart, footer at 0.4s, keyboard hint at 0.52s; restored rows stagger back in the same way; every timer is cleared on unmount

responsive.button: intrinsic width; sm keeps a 44px touch target
responsive.demo: card is fluid to 600px; workspace footer stacks below @md (28rem) and sits in a row above

accessibility: aria-describedby: 'Press and hold for N seconds to confirm.'
role=status live region announces success (announcement prop) or the error
Space and Enter hold from the keyboard; implicit click prevented; key repeat ignored
aria-busy while pending; disabled is 40% opacity with cursor-not-allowed
touch-action manipulation, no selection, no iOS callout, context menu suppressed

content.demoFooter: Delete workspace: Removes every project, preview and domain in Northwind. There’s no undo. Error: Detach 2 domains first

avoid: the button changing width between states
confetti, glow or sparkles on success
a confirm modal on top of the hold
animating progress with CSS transitions (it must reverse mid-flight)
hard-coded colours that ignore the accent prop
